page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top left with the page number at top left. No marginal notes. Catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.p: 3. Forma huius fidei est, non solum [illegible, ~12 letters] historiam de Christo Redemtore comprehendere: nec tantum [illegible, ~10 letters] thesi, de salute per ipsum fidelibus parta, assentiri: sed etiam [illegible, ~12 letters] per Spiritum sanctum accensa, [illegible, ~8 letters] de nostra ipsorum salute sic statuere, ut nullus planè locus sit Academicae [illegible, ~6 letters], aut haesitationi dubium aliquod in promissione gratiae, hoc est, in scyrpo nodu quaerenti.

4. [illegible, ~10 letters] est Deus, qui per Spiritum sanctum accedit fidem in cordibus filiorum Dei. Iuxta dicta: 2.Cor.4.13. Et quia habemus eundem Spiritum fidei: hoc est, fidem a Spiritu sancto in mentibus nostris accensam. Gal.5.22. inter fructus Spiritus recensetur fides.

Pie Augustinus in epistola ad Sixtum, quae est numero cv. Restat igitur, inquit, ut ipsam fidem, unde omnis iustitia sumit initium, propter quam dicitur ad Ecclesiam in Canticorum, Venies & pertransfibis ab initio fidei: non humano, quo isti extolluntur, tribuamus arbi-

page.notes: Greek words are illegible at this scan resolution and are marked, not guessed. Four Greek phrases in paragraphs 3 and 4 are affected. The Greek heading-like term after "4." is the least certain reading. "scyrpo nodu" and "metibus" are printed as shown and may be printing errors. "Canticorum" is read from "Cantico" in the scan. The catchword "trio" is printed at the bottom right after the hyphenated "arbi-".
